name: Fuel

text.ability: Burn it as the survivor sets out: moves by that survivor this turn skip the exposure roll.

sources.play: R p10; BGG card-spread; BGG ludopedia-51114

notes: src: items-sources.md Starting items / Fuel. RULING: Fuel is a grant (noExposureOnMove, one chosen survivor, this turn) played before a normal move that still costs its die; the M1 fixture encoded it as a free move (moveSurvivor, countsAs move), which the BC/P/R wording ("when moving a survivor you control, skip the exposure roll for that move") does not support.
